metadata.raw_content:
[​​Army Combat Fitness Test Events](https://www.army.mil/acft/)  

**1.** In 5 minutes, establish a 3-rep-max [deadlift](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-deadlift)    
    _Rest 2:00_  
**2.** For distance: [standing power throw](https://www.army.mil/acft/#event2)   
    _Rest 3:00_  
**3.** Complete as many reps as possible in 2 minutes of: [hand-release push-ups](https://www.army.mil/acft/#event3)   
    _Rest 3:00_  
**4.** For time: [sprint, drag, carry](https://www.army.mil/acft/#event4)  
    _Rest 4:00_    
**5.** [Max plank hold](https://www.army.mil/acft/#event5)   
    _Rest 2:00_   
**6.** For time: [run 2 miles](https://www.army.mil/acft/#event6)

Complete all [six ACFT](https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLr_5M5FiwX8gmAIq7IhRi8o5u2k9qn1qo) events and post scores to comments. Celebrate the [U.S. Army’s Birthday](https://www.army.mil/1775/) and learn more about the ACFT [here](https://www.army.mil/acft/).

Newer athletes should focus on maintaining sound mechanics on the deadlift triple, and reduce the distance on the run effort. Experienced athletes can choose to complete all [six events](https://www.army.mil/acft/) and see where they stack up. Post to comments.  

**Beginner Option:**    
Deadlift **3-3-3-3-3 reps**   

Complete as many reps as possible in 2 minutes of:  
Hand-release push-ups

For time:  
Run **1 mile**
